SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT A.BOARD_NO , A.TITLE , B.NICKNAME , DATE(A.REG_DTTM) AS REG_DT , A.REG_DTTM , A.VIEW_CNT , A.PARENT_NO , A.GROUP_NO , A.DEPTH , A.SORT_NO , A.USE_YN FROM TB_BOARD A JOIN TB_USER B ON A.USER_NO = B.USER_NO WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.REG_DTTM DESC ) T WHERE 1 = 1
AND T.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND T.NICKNAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND ( T.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR T.NICKNAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') )

SELECT A.BOARD_NO , A.TITLE , B.NICKNAME , DATE(A.REG_DTTM) AS REG_DT , A.REG_DTTM , A.VIEW_CNT , A.PARENT_NO , A.GROUP_NO , A.DEPTH , A.SORT_NO , A.USE_YN FROM TB_BOARD A JOIN TB_USER B ON A.USER_NO = B.USER_NO WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND A.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND B.NICKNAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND ( A.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR B.NICKNAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY A.REG_DTTM DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{perPage}

SELECT A.BOARD_NO , A.TITLE , A.CONTENT , A.USER_NO , A.REG_DTTM , A.VIEW_CNT , B.USER_ID , B.NICKNAME FROM TB_BOARD A JOIN TB_USER B ON A.USER_NO = B.USER_NO WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.BOARD_NO = #{boardNo}
